features.pool.title: Heated pool

features.garden.desc: Palm trees, banana trees and ambient lighting for your evenings.

villa.descriptionBody: Between mountains and lush garden, Villa R.E.E.L offers multiple living spaces, a heated pool, a tropical garden and unobstructed views of the alpine range. A place designed for families, team retreats and intimate events.
villa.availabilityDesc: See at a glance the available periods to plan your stay.
villa.locationDesc: The precise location is shared after booking confirmation. The map below shows the surrounding area.
villa.bookingNote: The exact amount will be calculated based on your dates, number of nights and any current promotions.
contact.title: Contact & inquiries
contact.subtitle: A question, a stay project, an event or a seminar? Share your wishes with us and we will get back to you quickly.
contact.bookDesc: Check availability and send a booking request directly through our dedicated form.
entreprises.title: Corporate & Seminars
entreprises.subtitle: Give your teams an inspiring setting between Alps and tropical garden for seminars, workshops, product launches and team-building activities.

entreprises.formulesTitle: Imagine your professional highlights at Villa R.E.E.L
entreprises.formule.desc: A warm setting for work sessions, creative workshops or inspiring presentations, with flexible indoor and outdoor spaces.
entreprises.why1.title: A haven outside the office
entreprises.why1.desc: Far from anonymous meeting rooms, a character house that fosters informal exchange, creativity and team spirit.
entreprises.why2.title: Indoor & outdoor spaces
entreprises.why2.desc: Living room, terrace, tropical garden and pool alternately become work, sharing or relaxation settings.
entreprises.why3.title: Tailor-made partners
entreprises.why3.desc: Catering, wine tasting, photography and event management services can be added according to your needs.

evenements.title: Events & celebrations
evenements.subtitle: Engagements, intimate weddings, birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties... Villa R.E.E.L becomes the backdrop for your most precious moments.
evenements.event1.title: Engagements
evenements.event1.desc: An intimate setting to celebrate your engagement surrounded by loved ones, between a warm living room and a green terrace.
evenements.event2.title: Weddings
evenements.event2.desc: A character house for a confidential wedding, where every space can be staged for your special day.
evenements.event3.title: Birthdays
evenements.event3.desc: An unforgettable birthday in a warm villa, with pool, tropical garden and carefully crafted lighting.
evenements.event4.title: Bachelor/Bachelorette
evenements.event4.desc: A chic and relaxed setting for a weekend with friends, between relaxation, games and evenings by the pool.
evenements.servicesSubtitle: Compose your event with our trusted partners, according to your wishes and budget.
evenements.service1.title: Private chef
evenements.service1.desc: Custom menus, food & wine pairings, brunches, cocktail dinners...
evenements.service2.title: Wine tasting with ViniLux
evenements.service2.desc: Wine selections, tasting workshops and food pairings around your meals.
evenements.service3.title: Decoration & scenography
evenements.service3.desc: Floral atmosphere, lighting design, table decoration and overall scenography.
evenements.service4.title: Photography & video
evenements.service4.desc: Professional capture of your event for lasting memories.
evenements.service5.title: Music & ambiance
evenements.service5.desc: DJs, live musicians, playlists and sound system tailored to your wishes.
evenements.service6.title: Event coordination
evenements.service6.desc: Support to orchestrate service providers and the flow of your day.
evenements.ctaTitle: Ready to imagine your event at Villa R.E.E.L?
evenements.ctaDesc: Share your project, wishes and ideal date. We will get back to you to build a tailor-made proposal.
galerie.title: Gallery
galerie.subtitle: Discover the villa in pictures: interiors, outdoors, pool, bedrooms and living spaces.
collaborateurs.title: Our Partners
collaborateurs.subtitle: Trusted partners to enrich your stay: wine tasting, gastronomy, bespoke experiences.
collaborateurs.vinilux.name: ViniLux
collaborateurs.vinilux.desc: Wine merchant and oenological partner, ViniLux offers wine selections, tasting workshops and food pairings for your evenings, seminars or private events at the villa.
collaborateurs.chef.name: Félicien Christe
collaborateurs.chef.desc: Private chef, Félicien Christe creates personalised menus, intimate dinners, brunches and cocktail dinners for your stays and events at Villa R.E.E.L.
collaborateurs.chef.note: On request, he can work for your private stays, corporate events or special celebrations.
collaborateurs.disclaimer: These services are optional and independent of the villa rental price. They are subject to separate quotes and invoicing from each service provider.
